rows.grounds: compound member naming the five elements
compound member indicating constitution by the five elements
the unit whose elemental constitution is stated
feminine adjective agreeing with the stated varṇa
states the elemental constitution of the varṇa

items.question: What elemental constitution characterizes the varṇa that the mantra practitioner contemplates?
premises: The varṇa is constituted by five elements.
The statement is introduced as a doctrinal conclusion.
items.inference: Therefore the varṇa embodies the nature of the five elements.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of varṇa in this passage is not specified.
items.plain_english: The varṇa is of the nature of the five elements, thus.
